text:
maria-cs: FYI customer on-prem reported 403s for embeddings in prod but staging works. Key provisioned via SSO. Anyone seen env-scoped scope stripping?
oliver-eng: Can you paste the curl + response? quick check: maybe provisioner tags env and drops scopes not allowed in prod.
maria-cs: Here's repro:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"message":"insufficient_scope","details":"missing:embeddings"}}
```
emma-ops: Do we have key metadata from auth-service?
provisioner-bot: metadata for sk_live_XXX -> {"env":"prod","scopes":["generation"]}
oliver-eng: aha — provisioner removed embeddings from prod keys. staging keys have ["generation","embeddings"]. likely a mapping rule that excludes embeddings for on-prem prod bundles.
maria-cs: Customer says they need both generation+embeddings. Repro steps for you: 1) call /internal/keymeta sk_live_XXX 2) confirm scopes 3) reproduce curl above.
sam-platform: I'll audit the provisioner rules. If it's intended we need an override flag. Emma — can you escalate to SSO infra to re-run provisioning for this tenant? :eyes:
emma-ops: On it. I'll run repro and create a rollback plan. If quick fix needed we can mint a short-lived key with proper scopes for the customer.
maria-cs: Thx. Customer wants ETA — assigned to sam-platform and emma-ops. Tag me when fixed. :thumbsup:
